title: Filipino national admits to illegal voting in 2024 US polls
summary: HONOLULU — A 20-year-old Filipino national and lawful permanent resident has pleaded guilty to illegally casting a ballot in the 2024 US presidential election, the US Department of Justice said.…

blocks.text: HONOLULU — A 20-year-old Filipino national and lawful permanent resident has pleaded guilty to illegally casting a ballot in the 2024 US presidential election, the US Department of Justice said. Bernadette Acaso, who previously lived in Honolulu and Kahului, admitted to voting despite not being a US citizen, according to the US Attorney’s Office for […]...
